content: Kiara Sen asked Vikram Patel about the next steps to renew her health policy that expired on Dec 10, 2026. Vikram apologized for the inconvenience, attached a renewal form, and requested that Kiara complete and return it by Dec 20, 2026, offering further assistance if needed.

action_items: Kiara to complete and return the renewal form by 2026-12-20
